properties.content:

Nearest City: Baltimore, MD
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: UNKNOWN MATERIAL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
AT LEAST A ONE ACRE LIGHT SHEEN WAS NOTICED NEAR AND AMONGST BOATS NEAR RED EYE YACHT CLUB LOCATED IN ESSEX, MARYLAND. MY BOAT IS DOCKED AT A PRIVATE HOME NEXT DOOR (EAST) OF THE YC. THE SHEEN WAS QUITE LARGE AND THE FIRST THING I NOTICED WHEN I STEPPED ON MY DOCK. AFTER PLACING SOME GEAR ON MY BOAT I WALKED OVER TO THE YC CENTER PIER AND NOTED PERSONS (2) WORKING ON A POWERBOAT. ONE INDIVIDUAL WAS ON A SWIM PLATFORM REACHING UNDER THE WATER. THERE WERE ALL KINDS OF TOOLS OUT AND ABOUT. THE BOAT WAS LOCATED NEXT TO A PONTOON BOAT AND THE SECOND BOAT ON THE RIGHT HAND SIDE HEADING OUT ON THE PIER. THE OIL WAS CLEARLY COMING FROM THAT BOAT AND THE SHEEN EXPANDED FROM THERE AND DRIFTED TOWARDS THE EAST. UPON RETURNING TO MY BOAT I CONTACTED SECTOR BALTIMORE VIA THE VHF RADIO. ALTHOUGH THE COMMUNICATION WAS POOR, A SHORT WHILE LATER A CG AUXILIARY BOAT WAS NOTED IN THE AREA. NOT VERY LONG AFTERWARDS I NOTED THE SOURCE BOAT BUTTONED UP - GREEN CANVAS. ONE OF THE INDIVIDUALS WAS STANDING ON IT IN A WHITE TEE SHIRT SEEMINGLY OBSERVING THE CG AUX BOAT IN THE AREA. PERHAPS ABOUT A HALF HOUR AFTER ORIGINALLY NOTING THE SHEEN I LEFT MY BOAT AND HEADED HOME. WHILE IN MY CAR I CALLED THE SECTOR AND WAS TOLD TO CONTACT THE NRC VIA THE 800 LINE. BY THAT TIME THE AMOUNT OF SHEEN ON TOP OF THE WATER HAD DECREASED SOME BUT WAS STILL PRESENT. I PRESUME MOST OF IT EVENTUALLY EVAPORATED OR DISSIPATED.

properties.title: NRC Report: Sodium Hydroxide near Statesville, NC
properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 851077 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: MOCARO DYING AND FINISHING
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 851077
Incident Time: 2007-10-08 15:00:00
Nearest City: Statesville, NC
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: SODIUM HYDROXIDE
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: MOCARO DYING AND FINISHING
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 4350 gallons
CALLER IS REPORTING A RELEASE MATERIALS FROM A STORAGE TANK DUE TO OPERATOR ERROR. THE INCIDENT OCCURED WHEN THEY ACCIDENTLY PUMPED 350 GALLONS OF SODIUM HYDROXIDE INTO A HYDROGEN PEROXIDE TANK. WHEN THE TWO MATERIALS MIXED IT CREATED A REACTION CAUSING THE TANK TO OVERFLOW AND DISCHARGE AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF MATERIAL INTO THE FLOOR DRAINS WHICH LEAD TO THE HOLDING TANKS/EQUALIZATION POND. AT THE SAME TIME THE SPRINKLERS WENT OFF DUE TO THE HEAT CREATED FROM THE REACTION. ABOUT 200,000 GALLONS OF WATER AND UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF THE MIXTURE OVERFLOWED THE ROOM AND REACHED A STORM DRAIN THAT LEADS TO A AN UNNAMED CREEK. THE CALLER STATED APPROXIMATELY 2 PERCENT OF THE PRODUCTS INVOLVED (INCLUDING THE WATER) ACTUALLY ENTERED THE DRAIN THAT LEADS TO THE CREEK. THE REST WENT INTO THE FACILITIES 400,000 GALLON CAPACITY HOLDING TANK/EQUALIZTION POND.
